description: This file defines the main React component for a simple note-taking application, managing state, effects, and interactions such as create, delete, save, and search of notes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages the notes application's state and UI.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and empty content, updates state, and sets it as selected.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, updates state optimistically, reverts if API call fails.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves updates to a note, performs an optimistic update, and reverts if API call fails.
